title: DAG foundation + automation
description: Foundation DAG epic covering DAG unit execution pipeline, manifest reading, and work-package generation for the compute/infra epic. Units are executed in topological order with validation and reporting.

units.title: DAG manifest schema and validator

units.title: Wire DAG executor to agileplus
